research:
I found only two real new openings from the last 14 days (20 Oct to 3 Nov). Most of what came up is 1 to 6 weeks old, or it's model news with no way to earn. I've marked the date on every item so nothing old gets presented as new. I read search summaries, not the pages themselves, so check each source link before it goes in a reel.

**New in the last 14 days**

1. **ElevenLabs Eleven Realtime (launched 20 Oct).** New speech-to-speech models for voice agents that answer calls and talk back. **Who earns and how:** freelancers with some tech skill could build a voice receptionist for a clinic, coaching centre or salon and charge them for it (CLIENT). **The catch:** it's a developer tool, not something a beginner can set up on a phone. Prices differ between listings. I couldn't find ElevenLabs' own launch page, only [Product Hunt](https://www.producthunt.com/products/elevenlabs-realtime).
2. **Remote AI training gigs posted 2 Nov.** OpenTrain lists remote AI training (RLHF) roles open to India, some dated 2 Nov. One example is building Godot game scenes and systems that are used to train AI. **Who earns:** students and freelancers who can code or have a specialist skill. **The catch:** OpenTrain lists other companies' gigs, so it isn't the company's own site. Under the MONEY.md rule it can't be named in a reel unless it's already in docs/MONEY.md. Pay wasn't checked. ([OpenTrain India](https://www.opentrain.ai/jobs/country/india/))

**Older but still open (fine for SITES, PRODUCT and the hostel Part 2)**

3. **Free Google AI Plus for Indian college students for 1 year (claim by 31 Dec 2026).** It gives 2x Gemini limits and 400 GB of storage. **Who earns and how:** students get a better AI tool free and can use it to do paid work like resumes, notes and posts. **The catch:** it's AI Plus, not AI Pro. You must be 18+ and verify as a student every year. ([Google India blog](https://blog.google/intl/en-in/products/start-the-academic-year-with-one-year-of-gemini-on-us/), [Gemini for Students](https://gemini.google/in/students/?hl=en-IN))
4. **Claude Docs, Slides and Design are out of beta on the Free plan (8 Oct, 26 days old).** **Who earns and how:** freelancers and students can make pitch decks, resumes and one-page flyers for local businesses with a free tool (GIG, CLIENT). **The catch:** the "free plan" detail came from a summary. Check it on [Anthropic's announcements page](https://www.anthropic.com/news/announcements) before saying it on camera.
5. **YouTube Shopping affiliates in India (24 Sept).** Creators in the YouTube Partner Program with 500+ subscribers can tag products and earn commission. Amazon, AJIO, Meesho, Snapdeal and Tata CLiQ are being added alongside Flipkart, Myntra and Nykaa. **Who earns:** small faceless or review channels (PRODUCT). **The catch:** you need the Partner Program first, and some of the new stores are still "rolling out soon". ([Google India: 500+ subscribers](https://blog.google/intl/en-in/products/platforms/earn-earlier-expanding-youtube-shopping-to-creators-with-500-subscribers/), [YouTube blog](https://blog.youtube/news-and-events/made-on-youtube-creator-monetization-shopping/))
6. **Instagram Edits Assistant (around 1 Oct).** A free chatbot inside the Edits app that reads your Reels data and suggests hooks, scripts and captions. **Who earns and how:** anyone selling reels to local shops (CLIENT). **The catch:** there's a daily prompt limit, and extra use comes through a paid Meta One subscription. I couldn't find Meta's own post. ([Deccan Herald](https://www.deccanherald.com/technology/artificial-intelligence/instagram-launches-new-ai-video-assistant-for-creators-4167890), [PetaPixel](https://petapixel.com/2026/10/01/instagram-launches-ai-assistant-that-analyzes-your-reels-and-suggests-new-ideas/))

**What freelancers are hired for (not new data)**

7. **Upwork's February report (2025 earnings vs 2024).** Fastest-growing AI work: AI video generation and editing +329%, AI integration +178%, data annotation +154%, chatbots +71%. Basic logos, blog writing and data entry are shrinking. This fits the SKILL ranking reel. **The catch:** this is Upwork's own data, I only saw it quoted on [SelfEmployed](https://www.selfemployed.com/news/ai-freelance-skills-demand-2026/), and it's months old. Fiverr's figures come from [Fiverr's own pages](https://www.fiverr.com/resources/guides/reports/freelancing-and-future-of-work-statistics).

**Scams to warn about**

8. **Fake AI training task jobs (no new official warning this fortnight).** The usual pattern: a small real payout first, then "pay a deposit to unlock bigger tasks". Scammers now copy the wording of real AI training jobs. Rule for the reel: real AI training never charges you a registration, training, kit or GST fee. If money is lost, call 1930 or report it at cybercrime.gov.in. Some blogs also mention deepfake video calls from fake HR people. ([HerWorkCircle](https://www.herworkcircle.com/guides/ai-training-jobs-from-home-india), [Bachao.ai](https://www.bachao.ai/blog/task-scam-telegram-job-fraud-india))
9. **Deepfake money videos.** PIB Fact Check flagged a fake AI video of FM Nirmala Sitharaman promoting a "₹70,000 a day" scheme (July/Aug). That's a trading scam, so it only works as a warning, never as a way to earn. ([Organiser](https://organiser.org/2026/07/31/372783/bharat/fact-check-pib-debunks-ai-deepfake-falsely-showing-fm-nirmala-sitharaman-endorsing-rs-70000-a-day-investment-scam/))

**What I left out and why**
- **Contests:** Google's Fund My Crazy (₹1 crore, closed 15 Sept) and Redrob's hackathon (closed July) are both shut. I found no creator fund open now.
- **Government AI jobs:** NeGD (closes 4 Nov) and VNMKV (closes 16 Nov) are for experienced engineers, not beginners.
- **ChatGPT visual ads in India:** a way for businesses to spend money on ads, not a clear way for beginners to earn.
- **Claude Haiku 5.5:** model news only.
- **MIB/IICT scholarships:** free courses with no cash, and from May.

**For this week:** item 3 (free Gemini for students) is the strongest new real way for the hostel Part 2. Item 8 can only be one entry inside a list, because the backfire theme is parked. Nothing here is strong enough for its own news reel this week.
